messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — my PR to update the SDK snippet for embeddings failed the docs CI (linkcheck + vale). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
ben: I can reproduce with `make docs-preview` — vale flags a passive-voice and a 'biased-language' rule on the example paragraph.
docs-bot: docs-preview check failed for PR #1234 — linkcheck: 2 broken external links; vale: 3 issues; mdspell: 1 misspelling. See https://ci.redwood.ai/job/preview/1234 for details.
carla: @alice can you paste the vale output and the exact failing lines?
alice: pasted output below:
```
VALE: docs/snippets/embedding.md:12: Passive voice: "is recommended" (Vocab/Passive)
VALE: docs/snippets/embedding.md:18: Biased language: "guys" (Bias/Inclusive)
MDLINK: docs/snippets/embedding.md:42: http://old.example.com/sdk -> 404
MDSPELL: docs/snippets/embedding.md:22: "embeddingss" -> "embeddings"
```
carla: Quick fixes: change "is recommended" -> "we recommend", replace "guys" -> "team" or reword, update broken link to canonical SDK doc. If you want faster merge we can footnote the link temporarily.
alice: I pushed a commit with the suggested wording and fixed the typo. Running `./scripts/docs/preview-rerun.sh pr-1234` now.
docs-bot: Re-run started for PR #1234 — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1234 (will post status when done)
jen: I'll take a review pass after stand. If this is still flaky we can merge with a footnote and follow up.
alice: Adding a footnote fallback and a changelog entry. Patch snippet: 
```diff
- For best results, utilize the embedding client in async mode, guys.
+ For best results, use the embedding client in async mode.
+ (Footnote: older SDK guide temporarily referenced below until migration completes)
@@
- See old SDK guide: http://old.example.com/sdk
+ See SDK guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/embedding
```
sam: small nit — can you add a one-line example response so users can quickly verify? Not required for CI but helps reviewers.
ben: Preview logs look better: linkcheck now passes but vale still flags the vague phrase "simple wrapper" in the snippet heading.
carla: That one is borderline. Our rule flags vague terms, but for an example it's acceptable. I'll mark it as waivable in the ruleset and note in the PR comment.
carla: @jen if you can approve, can we queue this for the 16:00 merge slot? We want to avoid the nightly heavy publish window.
jen: 16:00 works for me. I will post approval once docs-bot reports green.
docs-bot: Preview succeeded for PR #1234 — linkcheck: passed; vale: waived issues noted; mdspell: passed. All checks green ✅
alice: Merged to main. Thanks everyone :tada: 
ben: Nice — thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
jen: I'll keep an eye on the docs publish job and confirm the SDK page updates after the 4pm deploy.
